verdict.rationale: ESD's open filing guidance says up front that online filing needs an EAMS account, reached by logging into SecureAccess Washington (SAW), and it points to a setup video and an eServices account-creation guide. That names the account and credential layers before a founder starts, but nothing describes identity-proofing steps or gives an exact, complete list of prerequisites, and the setup detail sits in videos rather than a published checklist. missing for 10: explicit identity-proofing/verification requirements, an exhaustive written list of every account and credential step before filing, independent or hands-on corroboration that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: Log into SecureAccess Washington (SAW) to access EAMS and make changes to your quarterly report.
If you do not have an EAMS account, watch this 3-minute video for a step-by-step guide to setting up an account.
Learn how to create an account and combine eServices with the Employer Account Management System (EAMS).
